findings.title: Waterings page crashes on a malformed /api/waterings response; navigation silently stays on the previous page
findings.expected: Waterings page opens and shows an error message
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'; URL changes to /waterings but the Beds page stays rendered with no error shown
findings.evidence: {"url":"/waterings","headings":["Beds","Add a bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"],"alerts":[]} | {"url":"/waterings","headings":["Beds","Add a bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"],"alerts":[]}

findings.title: Dashboard 'Recent waterings' shows 'No waterings yet' when the response is not a list
findings.expected: An invalid response is shown as an error, not as an empty log
findings.actual: With an empty-object response the card says 'No waterings yet' although waterings exist

findings.title: 'Water now' on a second bed is not disabled while its request runs
findings.expected: Each bed's Water now button stays disabled until its own request finishes
findings.actual: A single shared wateringBedId is cleared when the first bed's request finishes, so the second bed's button is enabled again while its request is still running (and the first bed's 'Watered' notice is lost)
